For any caller, if AdjustBetAmounts succeeds then the caller must be the owner; the reference always satisfies this while the mutant allows a non-owner to succeed and change the bet limit.

For any caller, after a successful AdjustBetAmounts the state variable OpenToThePublic remains unchanged; the reference always satisfies this invariant, while the buggy version allows a non-owner to change the bet limit, which does not modify OpenToThePublic, so the test must target a different differentiator.
After a successful call to OpenToThePublic(), the openToPublic state variable must be true; the buggy version leaves it false.
For any caller, after owner calls OpenToThePublic(), the function OpenToThePublic should set openToPublic to true; the buggy version sets it to false, so getter openToPublic() returns false.
After the contract owner calls OpenToThePublic(), the public getter openToPublic() must return true; the buggy contract sets it to false, so the getter returns false.
After owner calls OpenToThePublic(), any subsequent call to wager() by a real person with correct msg.value should succeed; the buggy version leaves openToPublic false, causing wager() to revert.

After the contract owner calls OpenToThePublic(), a call to wager() by a real person with correct msg.value either succeeds or reverts depending on the openToPublic flag. In the reference contract it succeeds, but in the buggy contract it reverts because openToPublic remains false.

After OpenToThePublic is called by the owner, the public view openToPublic must return true in the reference; in the buggy version it stays false (the default), so a subsequent call that requires isOpenToPublic will revert.

After owner calls OpenToThePublic, a non-owner real person must be able to call donate() without revert; the buggy version leaves openToPublic false, so donate() reverts with isOpenToPublic modifier.

In the reference, when the contract is closed (openToPublic is false), the onlyOwner function OpenToThePublic can still be called by the owner; after the fix, OpenToThePublic does nothing, so the contract remains closed; therefore, a subsequent owner call to wager() (which requires isOpenToPublic) will succeed in the reference but revert in the buggy version.
